channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Em convenção, PDT, de Carlos Lupi, oficializa apoio à pré-candidatura de Lula à reeleição
item.description: The PDT officially endorsed Lula's re-election bid at its national convention in Brasília, approved unanimously, with Carlos Lupi emphasizing the party's historical reunion with the president. The endorsement anticipates the decision not to field a own candidate following Ciro Gomes' move to the PSDB, positioning the PDT as the first party to formally support Lula's campaign.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei do Complexo Econômico-Industrial da Saúde
item.description: President Lula signed into law the National Health Strategy of the Economic-Industrial Health Complex, aiming to reduce import dependence by promoting local production of medicines, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and medical equipment. The law amends procurement and health legislation, establishes criteria for strategic health companies, and provides tax incentives, BNDES financing, and preference margins in public purchases—provided they meet at least 30% of SUS demand. The law was signed with three presidential vetoes and awaits regulation via a Ministry of Health decree.

item.title: Lindbergh sobre Eduardo Bolsonaro: "Traidor da pátria com green card"
item.description: Congressman Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) accused former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) of being a "traitor of the homeland" for receiving a U.S. green card, claiming it was a reward for advocating sanctions against Brazilian officials and supporting U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods. He argued that the green card granted to Eduardo, his wife, and children reflects a pattern of favoritism for serving U.S. interests, questioning whether Bolsonaro will next seek U.S. citizenship.

item.title: Weverton: PDT toma decisão estratégica de apoiar Lula e não abrirá mão de seus projetos
item.description: Senator Weverton Rocha (PDT-MA) stated that the PDT's decision to support Lula's reelection is political and strategic, while maintaining the party's own projects for Brazil. He emphasized that the PDT will continue working on its national project and dreams of seeing the PT support this initiative.

item.title: Tempo de TV: Flávio depende de apoio do Centrão para não ficar atrás de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro needs to attract Centrão parties like Republicans and Podemos to secure more TV and radio ad time than Lula in 2026. Without them, Lula leads with 5 minutes 34 seconds per block versus Flávio’s 4 minutes 18 seconds. Only four pre-candidates would qualify for free airtime: Lula, Flávio, Ronaldo Caiado, and Augusto Cury.

item.title: Relator da CPI do Crime Organizado chama decisão da PGR de ‘tentativa de intimidação’
item.description: Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE) described the Prosecutor General's Office dispatch, which forwarded a representation by Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes to Sergipe's Electoral Prosecutor's Office, as an absurd and illegal attempt at intimidation. Vieira said the representation stems from his report in the Organized Crime CPI, which proposed indicting Mendes, Toffoli, Moraes, and Gonet for responsibility crime, although the PGR dismissed the abuse of authority charge and retained only the possibility of an electoral offense.

item.title: Vieira: decisão da PGR sobre ação de Gilmar é tentativa de intimidação
item.description: Former rapporteur of the Organized Crime CPI, Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE), called the PGR's decision an 'absurd and illegal' attempt at intimidation, arguing that the office overstepped by reviewing the CPI's request to indict Supreme Court ministers Gilmar Mendes, Dias Toffoli, and Alexandre de Moraes for responsibility crimes in the Master Case. Vieira claimed the PGR reframed the issue as a potential electoral offense to avoid addressing abuse of authority, and reaffirmed his commitment to equal justice despite the risks of challenging powerful figures in Brasília.

item.title: Dino manda resposta de Valdemar sobre emendas para a PF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered that responses from PL president Valdemar Costa Neto and PSD president Gilberto Kassab regarding their involvement in parliamentary amendments be sent to the Federal Police, amid suspicions of irregular resource allocation by party leaders without congressional mandates. Valdemar’s defense stated his role is limited to gathering municipal demands and suggesting amendments, without influencing parliamentary decisions, and denied the legal existence of a 'party president’s amendment' as a category.

item.title: Nobel de Economia critica tarifaço dos EUA sobre o Brasil
item.description: Nobel laureate economist Paul Krugman criticized the U.S. 25% tariff on Brazil as an unjust punishment for the Pix payment system, which he defends as comparable to requiring U.S. banks to accept dollar bills. He argues the tariff, based on Section 301 of the 1974 Trade Act, will fail and may politically strengthen President Lula.

item.title: PL pede que TSE investigue suposta rede de impulsionamento em massa criada para atacar Flávio
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) has asked the TSE to investigate an alleged mass content boosting network involving nearly 20,000 fake profiles that reportedly spent up to R$3 million on negative content targeting pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and allies, including the governors of São Paulo and Santa Catarina. The PL seeks court-ordered disclosure from Meta to identify sponsors and administrators, describing the operation as a possible digital criminal organization that erased digital traces after posting, which violates electoral rules prohibiting boosted negative campaigning.

item.title: Após processo de 'Bob Esponja' contra 'Lula Molusco', TJ-MS diz que apura irregularidades
item.description: The TJMS is investigating the public exposure of test proceedings containing fictitious references to 'Lula Molusco' and 'SpongeBob SquarePants', used in internal training between 2006 and 2018. State deputy Gleice Jane (PT) denounced the leak, which included terms like 'Lula Petralha' linked to crimes such as drug trafficking, although the court stated the data had no legal effect. The case was referred to the CNJ and MPMS, and the TJMS removed the proceedings from public access following the backlash.

item.title: PL pede investigação contra “rede” de 20 mil perfis falsos contra Flávio
item.description: The PL filed a complaint with the TSE alleging a network of 20,000 fake profiles on Meta platforms was used to amplify negative propaganda against Flávio Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Cleitinho Azevedo. The party claims the boosts were paid in reais, Colombian pesos, and dollars, using fake CPFs and deleted accounts to avoid traces, characterizing it as a criminal organization targeting the right. The PL requests the TSE to authorize an urgent investigation to identify funders and remove the profiles.

item.title: Patrus Ananias confirma que disputará o Governo de MG em chapa de apoio a Lula
item.description: Patrus Ananias, federal deputy, former minister and former mayor of Belo Horizonte, confirmed he will run for Governor of Minas Gerais in 2026 as part of the political coalition supporting President Lula (PT). His candidacy formalizes the federal government's backing of the PT in the state.

item.title: Sudeste perde eleitores, mas segue como maior colégio eleitoral
item.description: The Southeast remains Brazil's largest electoral college with 66.3 million voters, despite losing 378,090 since 2022. The Northeast grew to 43.5 million voters, while the national total reached 158.7 million, with strong growth in the North (4.37%) and abroad (31.82%). São Paulo leads the states with 34.1 million voters, followed by Minas Gerais and Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: PL diz ao TSE ter identificado 57 perfis falsos em campanha contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The leadership of the PL party claims to have identified 57 fake profiles on Meta's social media platforms used to boost content opposing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, and has asked the TSE to investigate what it believes is a criminal scheme. The party requests action to counter what it describes as electoral disinformation targeting its candidate.

item.title: PT coloca ex-aliado de Jair Bolsonaro em chapa de Lula em Pernambuco
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) in Pernambuco confirmed Senator Humberto Costa's re-election bid and named federal deputy Luciano Bivar, a former Bolsonaro ally and ex-president of PSL and União Brasil, as his first substitute. Bivar, now affiliated with MDB, retains right-wing ideals and was selected in a meeting on Saturday, the 18th, to join the ticket supporting João Campos (PSB) for governor against incumbent Raquel Lyra (PSD). The move complicates Campos’ effort to portray himself as the sole Lula-aligned candidate, given his past support from PL figures.

item.title: Substituição do Bolsa Família, fim das cotas e mudanças na Lei Rouanet: as propostas de Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, proposes replacing Bolsa Família with the Frentes Cidadãs program, ending racial quotas, merging the Culture and Education ministries, implementing fiscal adjustment through de-indexation of benefits from the minimum wage, reforming the Lei Rouanet, and hardening security policy with supermax prisons and 'Enemy Criminal Law'. The document also harshly criticizes Bolsonarism, labeling Jair Bolsonaro's government as a 'lamentable episode'.

item.title: Federação com PT, PV e PCdoB lança Humberto Costa ao Senado por PE
item.description: The Hope Brazil Federation (PT, PV, and PCdoB) launched Humberto Costa (PT) as its Senate candidate for Pernambuco in the 2026 elections during a convention in Recife. The ticket includes Marília Arraes (PDT) as a Senate candidate and Carlos Costa (Republicanos) as the vice-gubernatorial candidate, while supporting João Campos (PSB) for governor. The parties also announced proportional candidacies for state and federal deputies.

item.title: Marinho: recusa de Flávio à escolta da PF foi estratégia da campanha
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) presidential campaign, stated that the pre-candidate’s decision to decline Federal Police escort was a strategic campaign move, not a lack of confidence in the institution. Marinho noted that certain aspects of the case still need clarification, without specifying them. The statement followed the PL’s filing with the TSE requesting an investigation into an alleged ‘criminal digital network’ that allegedly spent R$ 200,000 on ads against Flávio via profiles with around 30 followers.

item.title: Vice de Flávio só será anunciado após convenção, diz Rogério Marinho
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) stated that the vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) ticket will not be announced until after the PL convention on July 25, as the decision hinges on ongoing negotiations with allied parties, particularly the Republicans. He criticized restrictions on Bolsonaro's political contact, comparing them to the treatment of Lula in 2018, and said the PL aims to double its number of state-level electoral slates compared to 2022.

item.title: Lula parabeniza Andy Burnham, novo primeiro-ministro do Reino Unido
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva congratulated Andy Burnham on his official appointment as the new Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, emphasizing the over 200-year diplomatic relationship between Brazil and the UK and expressing intent to strengthen bilateral cooperation on democracy, multilateralism, and sustainable development.

item.title: Renan Santos se diz 'lisonjeado' após ser citado por Ciro Gomes como opção à Presidência
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, said he felt honored and energized after Ciro Gomes (PSDB) mentioned him as a potential supporter in the 2026 presidential race. Ciro, who is running for governor of Ceará, stated he is considering backing Renan in the presidential election.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro contesta proibição a visitas de Flávio
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro filed a petition with the Supreme Federal Court (STF) against Justice Alexandre de Moraes' decision to ban Senator Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting the former president for 90 days, following the release of a letter written by Bolsonaro. The request seeks to overturn the precautionary measure imposed by the justice.

item.title: Saiba quantos eleitores estão aptos a votar na sua cidade
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) announced that Brazil will have 158,745,463 eligible voters for the 2026 elections, a historic record. The first round will be held on October 4, with a potential second round on October 25. São Paulo leads with 9.1 million voters, followed by Rio de Janeiro (5.0 million) and Brasília (2.3 million), while the state of São Paulo has the largest electoral college in the country with 34.1 million voters.

item.title: O apelo de Jair Bolsonaro a Moraes para voltar a receber visitas de Flávio
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro appealed to Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF to overturn the 90-day suspension of visits by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, arguing the measure violates the right to legal defense and family interaction, and exceeds the principles of necessity, adequacy, and proportionality.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: o embate entre Biden brasileiro e Flávio radicalizado
item.description: On Papo Antagonista, the radicalization of Flávio Bolsonaro following an event in Espírito Santo was discussed, along with a new gaffe by Lula, who confused 'health' with 'education' in speech. The show highlighted the contrast between Lula's new gaffe where he confused 'health' with 'education' during a speech. The program contrasted Lula's moderate, 'Brazilian Biden'-like image with Flávio Bolsonaro's increasingly aggressive tone.

item.title: Após green card, Eduardo diz se sentir "seguro" dos "abusos" de Moraes
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro said he feels safe in the United States after receiving a green card from the Trump administration, claiming that the 'abuses' of STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes have no validity there. He explained that he self-exiled to the U.S. in February 2025 due to legal proceedings in Brazil and now, with permanent residency secured for himself, his wife, and their two children, he can live without fear of political persecution. Eduardo also emphasized that his brother Flávio Bolsonaro’s victory in the 2026 presidential election is essential to restore 'democratic normality' in Brazil and end the exile of politicians.

item.title: A pesquisa Quaest sobre quem os brasileiros acham que vai vencer a eleição para presidente
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll released on July 20, 2026, shows that 55% of Brazilians believe President Lula (PT) will be re-elected, compared to 25% who expect Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to win. Belief in Lula’s re-election has increased by six percentage points since April, when it stood at 49%. The survey interviewed 2,004 Brazilians between July 10 and 13, with a margin of error of two percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Moraes cita condenações de Bolsonaro e Ramagem por trama golpista e arquiva investigação sobre 'Abin paralela'
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes archived the investigation into the so-called 'parallel Abin' regarding Jair Bolsonaro, Alexandre Ramagem, and others, stating the facts were already analyzed and led to convictions in the coup plot case. He also dismissed investigations against other individuals due to insufficient evidence and ordered the transfer of remaining proceedings to federal first-instance court, involving Carlos Bolsonaro and others, to continue examining alleged crimes such as criminal organization and illegal interception.

item.title: Republicanos escolhe Anthony Garotinho para concorrer ao governo do Rio
item.description: The Republicans party in Rio de Janeiro unanimously approved former governor Anthony Garotinho as its pre-candidate for the 2026 gubernatorial election, based on a survey from Instituto PREFAB FUTURE. The decision will be ratified at the party's State Convention on July 25, 2026. Garotinho faces multiple legal proceedings, including charges related to the Chequinho operation, whose conviction was annulled by the STF in March 2026.

item.title: Patrus, Marília e a reconstrução eleitoral de Lula e do PT em Minas Gerais
item.description: Minas Gerais has been a strategic state for the PT in presidential elections since 2006 due to its regional heterogeneity and electoral college importance. Despite strong performances in regions like Northern Minas and the Jequitinhonha and Mucuri valleys, the PT faced significant difficulties in the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region in 2022, where Lula won only in Ribeirão das Neves, losing to Bolsonaro in 33 of 34 municipalities. Regaining competitiveness in major urban centers, especially Belo Horizonte, is identified as a central challenge for Lula and the PT's electoral reconstruction in 2026.

item.title: PL aciona TSE para derrubar suposta organização criminosa digital contra Flávio
item.description: The PL filed a request for a preliminary injunction with the TSE to identify fake profiles allegedly attacking right-wing candidates, including Flávio Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Fretas, and Jorginho Mello. The party claims to have detected over 20,000 fake profiles with investments of up to 20 million reais, involving payments in reais, Colombian pesos, and dollars, and urged Minister Kassio Nunes Marques to review the case 'as soon as possible'.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro recorre de decisão que suspendeu visitas de Flávio por 90 dias
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro has appealed to the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to overturn a 90-day suspension of visits from his son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, arguing the measure is disproportionate and that Bolsonaro was unaware the letter would be publicized. The lawyers request that, if family visits are not restored, Flávio be allowed to meet with Bolsonaro as his legal counsel, given his role in the defense team. They ask that, if unresolved, the appeal be reviewed by the First Chamber of the STF.

item.title: Equipe de Flávio se reúne com presidente do TSE para pedir quebra de sigilo de perfis falsos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign team met with TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques to request the breaking of secrecy on approximately 20,000 fake social media profiles allegedly conducting coordinated, funded attacks with disqualifying content against the senator, violating electoral law. The team claims the profiles are created, boosted with payments in Brazilian reais, Colombian pesos, and U.S. dollars, then swiftly deleted, and has filed a special representation seeking a preliminary injunction for investigation and removal of the accounts.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro pede a Moraes que visitas de Flávio ao ex-presidente sejam reestabelecidas
item.description: The defense of former President Jair Bolsonaro has asked Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to reconsider the ban on visits from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro during his father’s house arrest, arguing the measure is disproportionate and violates international norms on family contact. The suspension followed Flávio’s sharing of a handwritten letter from Jair Bolsonaro on social media, which Moraes deemed a misuse of visitation rights and a breach of the social media ban. If denied, the defense requests the case be reviewed by the First Chamber of the STF.

item.title: Mulheres avançam mais e são 52,8% do eleitorado em 2026, diz TSE
item.description: The female electorate in Brazil's 2026 elections will reach 83.8 million women, representing 52.8% of the total 158.7 million eligible voters, according to the TSE. This reflects a 1.83% increase from 2022, outpacing the 1.08% growth in the male electorate, which will reach 74.8 million. The TSE also released historical data since 2010, showing a sustained upward trend in women's participation in the Brazilian electorate.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro apresenta recurso contra proibição de visitas de Flávio
item.description: The defense of former President Jair Bolsonaro filed a petition against the visit ban imposed on his son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The petition argues the ban violates international human rights treaties and the Penal Execution Law, emphasizing that Flávio, as a licensed attorney in the case, has a constitutional right to visit his father. The ban was imposed after Flávio read a letter written by Bolsonaro during a live stream, which Moraes interpreted as an attempt to circumvent the ex-president’s social media restrictions.

item.title: Governo Trump concede green card para Eduardo Bolsonaro viver nos EUA, diz aliado
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro has received a U.S. green card, granting him permanent residency and the right to live, work, and study in the United States. He was convicted by Brazil’s Supreme Court (STF) to four years and two months in prison for coercion related to his activities in the U.S. aimed at intimidating the judiciary and blocking analysis of the coup attempt. Still residing in the U.S. since February 2025, he recently criticized the suspension of visits to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, and suggested other countries should not recognize Brazilian presidential elections as democratic.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Calendário de convenções começa com indefinição dos vices de Flávio Bolsonaro e Zema
item.description: The 2026 party convention calendar begins with uncertainty over vice-presidential picks for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and Romeu Zema (NOVO-MG). Both gubernatorial pre-candidates have yet to confirm their running mates, creating political uncertainty. This lack of definition may affect regional and national alliances amid growing electoral polarization.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro deve fazer convenção neste sábado sem ter vice definido, diz coordenador
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and presidential candidate for PL-RJ, is expected to hold his electoral convention this Saturday (25) in São Paulo without having defined a vice-presidential running mate, due to difficulties in forming alliances with other parties. The campaign coordinator confirmed the ticket will be incomplete at the event, which may affect perceptions of electoral viability. The convention takes place amid party fragmentation and challenges in consolidating national support.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro pede a Moraes volta das visitas de Flávio ao pai antes da eleição
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro asked Minister Alexandre de Moraes to reconsider the ban on visits from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, arguing it is disproportionate and infringes on family conviviality. They claim Bolsonaro was unaware the letter supporting his son's presidential pre-candidacy would be made public, citing a similar letter from December 2023 that went unchallenged. The defense requests Moraes either reverse the decision or refer it to the First Chamber of the STF for ruling.

item.title: Como fica Carlos Bolsonaro, após decisão de Moraes no caso Abin Paralela
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the transfer of the 'Parallel Abin' investigation to the Federal Justice of the Distrito Federal, keeping former councilman Carlos Bolsonaro as a target of the inquiry. Attorney General Paulo Gonet had opined that the facts lacked an immediate link to privileged jurisdiction in the STF, justifying the removal from the Supreme Court's docket. Regarding Jair Bolsonaro, Alexandre Ramagem and two others, Moraes ruled for dismissal, as the facts had already been judged in the coup plot case.

item.title: Perfis de 30 seguidores gastaram R$ 200 mil para atacar Flávio, diz PL
item.description: The PL filed a request with the TSE for an investigation after discovering that profiles with only around 30 to 40 followers had allegedly spent R$200,000 on paid ads via Meta targeting Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president in 2026. The campaign describes this as a 'digital militia' using temporary, ghost-like accounts possibly backed by organized funding, including payments in reais, dollars, and Colombian pesos. The goal is to uncover the financiers and have the irregular accounts removed.

item.title: Abin Paralela: Moraes encerra investigações contra diretor da agência
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the immediate dismissal of investigations against Abin's director-general Luiz Fernando Corrêa and four other agency officials due to lack of evidence and absence of just cause in the 'Abin Paralela' case. The ruling also applies to former President Jair Bolsonaro, former Abin director Alexandre Ramagem, and two others, who had already been tried and convicted in a separate coup plot case. The allegations included obstruction of investigation, prevarication, and coercion, but the report was deemed too generic to support criminal liability.

item.title: Depois de colecionar nãos, Lula escolhe Patrus como plano D em Minas
item.description: Patrus Ananias, PT-MG federal deputy, was chosen as Lula's pre-candidate for Minas Gerais governor after rejections from Rodrigo Pacheco, Marília Campos and Alexandre Kalil. At 74, former Belo Horizonte mayor and Lula minister, he represents a late option (plan D) after failed talks with other parties. His career is marked by commitment to popular movements, Liberation Theology, and initiatives like Belo Horizonte's Participatory Budget.

item.title: Sakamoto: Mar está mais para peixe para Lula do que para Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Genial/Quest poll shows President Lula (PT) is perceived more favorably than Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 presidential race, according to columnist Leonardo Sakamoto on UOL News. Lula’s more positive perception suggests an early advantage, though the race remains in its initial stages.

item.title: Moraes arquiva investigação da Abin Paralela sobre Jair Bolsonaro, mas manda TRF-1 seguir apuração sobre Carlos
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes archived the investigation into the 'Parallel Abin' involving former President Jair Bolsonaro, ruling that the evidence had already been used in his conviction for attempting a coup in 2022. However, he ordered the case against Carlos Bolsonaro, the former president's son, to be transferred to the Federal Regional Court of the 1st Region for further investigation into alleged disinformation campaigns and illegal data use. The decision follows the PGR's opinion that matters concerning Bolsonaro have been fully adjudicated, while those involving Carlos require continued scrutiny for potential administrative crimes.

item.title: TSE participa de missão internacional para observar eleições em São Tomé e Príncipe
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) participated in the Electoral Observation Mission for the presidential elections in São Tomé and Príncipe from July 15 to 19, represented by International Affairs Deputy Director Tiago Wolff Beckert. The mission, organized by ROJAE/CPLP, monitored voting and vote counting, noting only minor delays that did not affect the regularity or transparency of the process.

item.title: 'Saúde é para quem pode pagar': fala de Lula circula fora de contexto
item.description: Social media posts distorted a statement by President Lula, claiming he said 'healthcare is for those who can pay,' when the quote was taken out of context. The viral clip omitted Lula’s criticism of the dismantling of the SUS and healthcare privatization, reversing the original meaning of his remarks.

item.title: PL fecha aliança com Progressistas e define chapa ao Senado no Piauí
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) has formed an alliance with the Progressistas (PP) in Piauí for the 2026 elections, nominating Ciro Nogueira (PP) and Tiago Junqueira (PL) as Senate candidates. The agreement aims to unify the opposition early to prevent vote fragmentation and reduce the likelihood of a runoff in the gubernatorial race, contrasting with the delayed coalition-building of 2022.
